is_interstitial_enabled.description: Kill switch for interstitials. Gate 4 of AdTriggerService.

is_stop_metronome_ad_enabled.description: Interstitial when the metronome is stopped, preloaded on play. Ships OFF: stopping is part of the practice loop, so the cooldown is the only thing keeping it tolerable.

min_seconds_between_fullscreen_ads.description: Minimum gap between ANY two fullscreen ads, on top of each format cap. Guards the try(rewarded) -> download(interstitial) double toll.

is_posthog_enabled.description: PostHog analytics sink. GA4 is unaffected. Needs POSTHOG_API_KEY in the build for the sink to come up at all.

is_stop_training_ad_enabled.description: Interstitial when a tempo-training run ends, preloaded on start. Ships OFF for the same reason.

mode_change_ad_format.description: interstitial | rewarded. Mode-change placement ONLY, so the experiment isolates one variable. The rewarded arm asks for opt-in first (AdMob requires it); declining still changes the mode.

is_ad_backoff_enabled.description: Backoff after a failed load cycle: 1 min doubling to 30 min. Read live. Turn OFF if fill drops and impressions suffer.

is_basic_mode_ads_enabled.description: Whether basic mode participates in advertising at all. App-wide, shared by every placement that respects it. Does not enable anything by itself — a placement still needs itsown switch.

is_app_open_ad_enabled.description: App-open ad on launch. Own format and own flow. Ships OFF: it is the first thing a user sees, which makes it the highest-risk placement in the app. Respects the basic-mode lever using the mode the launch RESTORES INTO.

is_ad_impression_logging_enabled.description: One Firestore write per real ad impression, into activity_logs. Feeds the back-office ads-per-session card. Fine for a months-long measurement, not for leaving on forever.

is_settings_ad_enabled.description: Fullscreen ad when a settings sheet closes after a change. Two extra rules are hard-coded and NOT configurable: never in basic mode, never while the metronome is playing.

is_rewarded_enabled.description: Kill switch for rewarded ads. Gate 4 of AdTriggerService.
